/usr/bin/openssl

commands.command:
sudo openssl genrsa -out /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.key 4096 2>&1 && sudo openssl req -x509 -new -nodes -key /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.key -sha256 -days 3650 \
  -subj "/CN=OS Comparison Root CA/O=OS Comparison" \
  -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" \
  -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" \
  -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash" \
  -out /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt && sudo chmod 600 /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.key && echo OK

commands.stdout:
subject=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison
issuer=CN=OS Comparison Root CA, O=OS Comparison
notBefore=Sep  3 12:00:38 2026 GMT
notAfter=Aug 31 12:00:38 2036 GMT
X509v3 Basic Constraints: critical
    CA:TRUE
X509v3 Key Usage: critical
    Certificate Sign, CRL Sign

commands.command: sudo cp /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/os-comparison-root-ca.pem && sudo update-ca-trust extract && echo OK

commands.stdout:
label: OS Comparison Root CA
    trust: anchor
    category: authority

commands.command: cd /tmp && sudo openssl genrsa -out leaf.key 2048 2>&1 && sudo openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=test.oscomparison.local" -out leaf.csr && sudo openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/os-comparison-ca/ca.key -CAcreateserial -days 365 -sha256 -out leaf.crt 2>&1 && openssl verify leaf.crt
commands.stdout:
Certificate request self-signature ok
subject=CN=test.oscomparison.local
leaf.crt: OK
